claims.text: Per-frame YOLO26x draws 43 W on Orin.

claims.text: Skipping every second frame loses 8.6 percentage points AP@50.

claims.label: supported

claims.text: Skipping four of five frames loses 28.8 percentage points AP@50.
claims.poster_quote: skipping four of five loses 28.8 points
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: skipping four out of every five frames loses 28.8 pp (47%)

claims.text: ALBIREO is a codec-free, detector-agnostic wrapper requiring no detector modification or retraining.
claims.poster_quote: ALBIREO is a codec-free, detector-agnostic wrapper requiring no detector modification or retraining
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: A LBIREO is, to our knowledge, the first detector-agnostic, codec-free, content-aware frame-skipping system for edge video object detection that requires no detector modification or detector retraining
claims.reason: Section I Introduction, page 1. The paper explicitly describes ALBIREO as codec-free, detector-agnostic, and requiring no modification or retraining.

claims.text: Evaluation uses 200 BDD100K dashcam clips.

claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: We evaluate A LBIREO on the BDD100K dataset’s multi-object tracking (MOT) validation split (200 dashcam clips, 7 object classes)
claims.reason: Section I Introduction, page 1. The paper explicitly states the evaluation uses 200 BDD100K dashcam clips.

claims.text: Evaluation involves about 40,000 annotated frames per configuration.

claims.label: supported

claims.text: Unchanged YOLO11x, YOLO26x, and RF-DETR-Large detectors run through PyTorch on AGX Thor and AGX Orin.

claims.reason: Section IV-A Experimental Setup, page 6. The paper explicitly states the detectors run unchanged through PyTorch on both platforms.

claims.text: Comparisons include Vanilla, three fixed-skip settings, CTD, Statues, and ERD-only.

claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: We compare A LBIREO against five families of frame-skipping baselines. Vanilla runs the detector on every frame. FixedSkip-N (N ∈ {2, 3, 5})... CTD [27]... Statues [3]... ERD-only...
claims.reason: Section IV-A Experimental Setup, page 6. The paper lists the comparison baselines explicitly.

claims.text: Metrics cover accuracy, frame time, clip energy, energy-delay product, skip rate, and five exclusive frame states.
claims.poster_quote: Metrics cover accuracy, frame time, clip energy, energy-delay product, skip rate, and five exclusive frame states
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: We report seven metrics. Detection accuracy is measured by AP@50 (VOC-style, IoU 0.5) and mAP@50:95 (COCO-style, IoU swept 0.5–0.95). Efficiency is measured by average frame time (ms), total clip energy (J), and per-frame energy-delay product (EDP). Runtime behavior is measured by skip rate (%) and the five-state frame breakdown defined in Section III-D.
claims.reason: Section IV-A Experimental Setup, page 6. The paper explicitly lists the metrics used in evaluation.

claims.text: YOLO26x GPU energy drops 17.5% on Thor.
claims.poster_quote: YOLO26x GPU energy drops 17.5% on Thor

claims.text: YOLO26x GPU energy drops 19.0% on Orin.

claims.text: On Orin, CPU utilization grows from approximately 7% to 23%.

claims.text: Sparse empty-road stretches sharply lower GPU power.

claims.label: supported

claims.reason: Section IV-H Per-Clip Behavior, page 12. The paper describes GPU power reduction during sparse empty-road stretches.

claims.text: Memory overhead is only 2–27 MB, below 0.7%.

claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: Across 200 clips in each of the six detector–platform configurations, A LBIREO adds only 2–27 MB of system memory relative to per-frame inference—below 0.7% in every case
claims.reason: Section IV-G Per-Domain Energy and Workload Shift, page 11. The paper explicitly states the memory overhead range.

claims.text: ALBIREO uses per-object uncertainty to gate off-the-shelf detectors without fixed-camera or codec assumptions.

claims.reason: Section I Introduction, page 1. The paper explicitly describes ALBIREO’s gating mechanism and deployment assumptions.

claims.text: ALBIREO includes an uncertainty trigger, rescue mechanism, and empty-scene screen.
claims.poster_quote: The next section describes its uncertainty trigger, rescue mechanism, and empty-scene screen
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: Three mechanisms compose its design: 1) Forward-looking uncertainty trigger... 2) Detector-flicker rescue... 3) Empty-scene screen...
claims.reason: Section III ALBIREO System Design, page 3. The paper explicitly lists the three mechanisms included in ALBIREO.

claims.text: Frame events route ALBIREO among empty-road skipping, prediction-only, normal inference, and rescue-augmented inference states.
claims.poster_quote: Frame events route ALBIREO among empty-road skipping, prediction-only, normal inference, and rescue-augmented inference states
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: Algorithm 1 gives the exact per-frame routing logic, combining Kalman prediction, boundary pruning, empty-scene screening, uncertainty-triggered skipping, detector matching, and rescue in a single pass
claims.reason: Section III-D Frame-State Taxonomy and Algorithm, page 5. The paper describes the routing among frame states.

claims.text: A per-object Kalman filter skips detection only while every projected covariance trace stays below threshold u.
claims.poster_quote: A per-object Kalman filter skips detection only while every projected covariance trace stays below threshold u
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: A LBIREO uses the projected covariance trace as its uncertainty signal: τ = tr HP H ⊤
claims.reason: Section III-A Per-Object Kalman Filter and Uncertainty Trigger, page 3. The paper explicitly describes the covariance trace threshold mechanism.

claims.text: Flicker rescue emits bounded predicted boxes for recent confident misses, without updating state.
claims.poster_quote: Flicker rescue emits bounded predicted boxes for recent confident misses, without updating state
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: A rescued state emits its Kalman-predicted bounding box for the current frame, but it does not receive a Kalman update because no real detector measurement was observed
claims.reason: Section III-B Detector-Flicker Rescue, page 4. The paper explicitly describes the rescue mechanism and its bounded behavior.

claims.text: With no active states, an approximately 14,000-parameter classifier screens frames in 1.3 ms on GPU.
claims.poster_quote: With no active states, an approximately 14,000-parameter classifier screens frames in 1.3 ms on GPU

claims.paper_evidence: ERD is a five-block CNN with ∼14k parameters and ∼1.3 ms GPU latency that labels a frame as empty or non-empty
claims.reason: Section III-C Empty-Scene Screening, page 4. The paper explicitly describes the classifier’s parameter count and latency.

claims.text: With RF-DETR-Large on Thor, energy falls 16.3%.
